cloudOff.name: skills_remove
cloudOff.description: Removes one skill on one computer or where a thread runs by its name, as the login it was added with: every folder skills lists for it and every link to it; a folder a link points to outside the skills folders stays. The skill wsp writes and a plugin's are always on and are refused; a napping machine is not woken. The report there reads again at once.

name.description: the skill's name, as skills lists it

thread.description: a thread, by its id or a prefix of it, whose computer and project to read; absent reads a computer

on.description: the computer to read, by the name computers lists; absent with no thread is the computer the app runs on

project.description: the project's skill of that name rather than the one that is not a project's: true with a thread, the thread's own project, or the project's name, as projects lists it, with on
